obfuscation_indicators: not expected to have a material impact
risk_summary: The disclosure is generally specific and well quantified, including customer concentration, cash flows, credit availability, covenant status, and factoring exposure. Key risks include dependence on two customers, cost inflation, foreign sourcing, litigation-related expenses, and the July 2016 facility maturity, although liquidity appears adequate with no revolver balance outstanding. Some standard hedging and generalized language limits precision around future performance and accounting impacts.
